name: Born Global Companies Discussion
description: Part 3 discussion questions about startups, international expansion, technology, and business networks
author: IELTS Practice Team

questions.text: 1. To what extent has digital technology made it easier for small startups to compete with large multinational corporations?
2. Some people believe that personal connections and cultural ties are more important for a new business than having formal legal contracts. Do you agree or disagree?
3. What do you think are the main challenges a company might face when it tries to expand from a familiar local market into a completely unfamiliar foreign market?
4. Do you think that in the future, all successful businesses will need to operate internationally from the very beginning, or will there always be a strong place for strictly local companies?
